the pKa values of organocatalysts are in the range 11.17–23.81, and that the pKa value of proline is 23.81.
the equilibrium acidity of proline derivatives in DMSO is significantly higher than in water, and that it can be tuned over a wide range by varying the substituents on the nitrogen atom.

the pKa values of proline derived catalysts were measured by an overlapping indicator UV/vis titration method in DMSO, and that the results were compared with the pKa values in DMSO of other organocatalysts.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the synthesis and evaluation of a series of proline derived N-heterocyclic carbenes.
the synthesis and the characterization of a new class of organocatalysts, based on the amino acid proline.
the synthesis and characterization of novel organocatalysts derived from proline.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the pKa value for the most acidic form of the catalyst is the highest for the catalyst with the highest steric hindrance, and vice versa.
the pKa values are not very sensitive to the substituents on the proline ring, and the pKa values of organocatalysts are not sensitive to the presence of an amide group.
the pKa of proline in DMSO is 12.9 and the pKa of the proline derived organacatalysts are 1-2 units higher.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the pKa values of proline derivatives are highly dependent on the nature and number of substituents and their location on the molecule.
the pKa of proline can be tuned by simple modifications.
